shots.name: 33-add-bundle
shots.script: (async()=>{ [...document.querySelectorAll('.ppg__kind')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Комплект'))?.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const inp=document.querySelector('[data-field="bundle-search"]'); if(inp){inp.focus(); const s=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; s.call(inp,'чай'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));} return true })()

shots.name: 35-space-opens-form
shots.script: (()=>{ document.body.focus(); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:' ',code:'Space',bubbles:true})); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:' ',code:'Space',bubbles:true})); return true })()
